notes: Skill, regime number and chi-square use the scored chords and scored rows of each target and population (rg.prepare); the pre-rule read-outs use every low-field chord with a finite T_i sample inside the population-W beam block.
The fixed running means (tau 15 ms, 40 ms) and the tuned one are exponentially weighted means of the visible samples of the chord; tau = 2.5 ms is the persistence limit.
Merged bins 0.9-1 and 0-0.7: sums of the bin sums for skill and fail share; the regime number is recomputed over the chords of the merged bin.
rho is a geometric midplane ratio from one EFIT scalar pair per discharge; the catalogue has no confinement-mode label, so the statements are about normalized radius, not about a pedestal.
Per-campaign and Bad-quality tables re-read the statements on subsets; only the primary set is the registered test.
